build_queuedconv1d: build a QueuedConv1d wrapper that maintains a deque buffer for streaming causal convolution inference
create_wavenetgenerator: create a WavenetGenerator from a WaveNet model to enable autoregressive audio sample generation
generate_audio_samples: generate audio samples from encodings using the WavenetGenerator generate method with sampling or argmax
init_generator_queues: initialize or reset the WavenetGenerator internal queues for a new batch size before generation
softmax_and_sample: sample from softmax prediction probabilities using multinomial sampling or argmax selection
